company.shortDescription: Walzay is a staffing and recruiting platform connecting companies with global talent across technology and business roles.
company.description: Walzay is a staffing and recruiting platform that connects companies with vetted global talent, particularly in technology, AI, finance, and leadership roles. The company operates as a hybrid recruitment marketplace and executive search firm, helping businesses source full-time, remote, and leadership professionals across multiple countries. Walzay also provides hiring management tools, candidate matching, and recruitment support for employers and job seekers worldwide.

productsAndServices.description: A platform connecting global leadership tech talent with companies for full-time and contractor roles, allowing profile creation, preference setting, and interview management.
productsAndServices.name: Walzay Talent Platform

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $261,000, or 75.98% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,326,842 to $3,817,486, a 2.88x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 60 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 52 (-11).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include wellfound, Hired, Toptal.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
